_comment: The only hand-edited settings for distribution/. Everything outside src/, schemas/ and this file is generated by scripts/build-distribution.mjs. The registry origin is the production store (PRODUCT.domain in core/src/product.ts); githubRepo is the public repo the generated tree is published to (docs/distribution.md, 'Launch'). `node scripts/build-distribution.mjs --check --launch` lists any that are left.
